purpose: Inspect bounded component counts, effective load demand ranges across snapshots, and snapshot count of one current-run model revision. load_p_set_mw is static defaults only; time-series values override it. Use load_demand_summary_mw and retain missing-snapshot and omitted-load counts.

model_ref.description: Current-run model_ref returned by model.open or a model derivation.

invalid_model_ref: Use a model_ref returned in the current run.
